title: CourseAsCode Assignment Activity
description: Schema for ASN_*.yaml (and legacy Assignment_*.yaml) Assignment activity files

Type.description: Activity type identifier — must be ASSIGNMENT

DueDate.description: Due date in ISO 8601 format, or null

CutoffDate.description: Last date submissions are accepted, or null

AllowSubmissionsFromDate.description: Date from which submissions are accepted, or null

AllowSubmissionDrafts.description: Allow students to save draft submissions

SendNotifications.description: Send notification emails when submissions are graded

SendLateNotifications.description: Send notification emails for late submissions

SendStudentNotifications.description: Notify students when their submission is graded

CompletionSubmit.description: Mark activity complete when student submits
